answer: Because the walnut index resolves every citation against the nadir checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 4560 identities would post 2145 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
